pillars_subtitle: Key services and infrastructure that make Baral Community a premium place to live.
pillar_elec_desc: Continuous power supply managed by dedicated grid maintenance teams.
pillar_water_desc: Regular quality checks and uninterrupted clean water distribution.

faq_subtitle: Quick answers to the most common queries about our community portal and services.
faq_q1: How do I register a complaint on the portal?
faq_a1: Log in to your account, go to the dashboard, and click 'Submit Complaint'. Choose the category (Electrician, Plumber, etc.) and write the details.
faq_q2: What should I do in case of an emergency?
faq_a2: You can immediately call the 24/7 Control Room helpline listed in the Emergency Helplines section below.
faq_q3: How long does it take to resolve a standard issue?
faq_a3: Most general complaints are investigated and resolved within 24 to 48 hours depending on complexity.
emergency_subtitle: Need urgent assistance? Contact our round-the-clock emergency desk directly.
about_hero_subtitle: Fostering collaboration, transparency, and top-tier public services for Baral Colony residents.
our_story_p1: Established to support WAPDA employees and families stationed near the historic Mangla Dam power generation plant, Baral WAPDA Community has grown into a vibrant, model residential neighborhood.
our_story_p2: Through this portal, we strive to build a digital bridge connecting residents directly with local administration to handle utility issues, security management, and regular sanitation work efficiently.
val_integrity_desc: Ensuring absolute transparency, ethical practices, and open communication across all services.
val_service_desc: Dedicated to fast response times, supportive care, and continuous development.
val_collaboration_desc: Promoting resident engagement and community participation in local initiatives.
val_excellence_desc: Delivering reliable electricity, water supply, and top-tier maintenance operations.
amenities_subtitle: Discover the key facilities and landmarks that make our community self-sustaining and comfortable.
amenity_power_desc: One of the largest hydroelectric power plants in Pakistan, providing clean energy to the nation and colony.
amenity_health_desc: A fully-equipped medical facility providing dedicated healthcare services to residents and staff.
amenity_sports_desc: Beautifully landscaped parks, playgrounds, and sports clubs promoting an active lifestyle.
